method: Each complete English/Dutch pair and each located current source consumer was read and given the manually authored per-entry rationale. Scripts assemble the report, independently rescan all current production Java/Kotlin, verify exact source identities and excerpts, placeholders, aliases and accounting; they do not infer linguistic acceptance.
hash_format: Value hashes use SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon; Android backslash escapes are retained. Raw UTF-8 hashes are separate.
limits: Model-based bounded linguistic and static-source review, not native-speaker or whole-language certification.

All 98 production Java/Kotlin files were hash-verified against the freshly fetched untruncated current tree; no Android layout XML exists in that tree. Shared source excerpts were independently matched and rescanned.

Thirty entries lack a located current direct consumer and receive no current-context credit; twenty-seven have acceptable wording only, three remain uncertain. Three further static-reference-only entries are wording-only because no current UI route was demonstrated. No assertion that these entries are dead code.
One current prior receipt is rebound without new credit; eight other Dutch prior receipts outside this selection are preserved without rereview or new credit.
Seven supported corrections are implemented only in the local patch and need independent review/integration before accepted corrected-entry credit.
Focused host text/resource tests are not Android UI execution, TalkBack, glyph, layout, performance, build or full-host-suite acceptance.
No GitHub publication or held PR56 writes occurred.
